keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.title: License
keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.desc: Status and configuration of the Xiro! license.
keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.info_desc: Save and validate the license to keep the service active.
keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.states_desc: Valid: the service is active. Invalid format: check that the key is typed correctly. Not valid: the license server rejected it.
keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.single_desc: Each license can only be active on one machine at a time. If you see "License in use on another machine", write to info@xiro.pro to release it.
keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.buy_desc: If no license is saved, the "Buy license" button opens the purchase page.
keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.exempt_desc: Lets you release or restrict content created by editors. Released content behaves as if it belonged to the administrator: with a site license it plays without limits.
keys.manual_admin.tools.licencia.publicurl_de: Used in email links (verification, registration) and in the PayPal return. Leave it empty for automatic detection by domain.
